subject.title: fix(agents): classify Anthropic invalid_request_error as format for failover

question: Should OpenClaw treat unprefixed structured `invalid_request_error` provider payloads as fallback-worthy `format` errors, including returned embedded error payloads, while preserving more-specific classifications?
rationale: The patch appears technically correct, but it changes provider/model routing for existing fallback configurations and maintainers need to accept that compatibility behavior before merge.

options.title: Accept Fallback Routing
options.body: Land this PR after normal exact-head checks if maintainers agree structured provider schema rejections should advance configured fallbacks.

options.title: Narrow The Classifier
options.body: Require a tighter rule if maintainers only want known Anthropic thinking/schema rejection shapes to fall back instead of all structured invalid-request payloads.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Consolidation
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer to consolidate the overlapping open sibling PR before choosing the final landing branch.

recommendation.title: Accept Fallback Routing
recommendation.body: Land this PR after normal exact-head checks if maintainers agree structured provider schema rejections should advance configured fallbacks.
